questions.question: What is the concept of a network society, and what are its defining characteristics?

  • society where social, economic, and cultural activities are organized through digital
  • communication networks.

  • Global Connectivity – People are connected across the world through the internet.
  • Information-Based Economy – Knowledge and information become key economic resources.
  • Digital Communication – Online interaction replaces many traditional forms of
  • communication.
  • Flexibility and Decentralization – Networks allow flexible and rapid exchange of information.
  • Virtual Communities – Social relationships increasingly occur in digital spaces.
  • The network society has transformed work, education, politics, and social relationships.
questions.final_answer: The network society has transformed work, education, politics, and social relationships.
